title: New isoxazole-based heterocyclic hybrids with dual antimicrobial and antioxidant bioactivity: integrated synthesis, in vitro assessment, and computational exploration
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13515-13528
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01005A, Paper

Aziz Arzine, Soumia Ait Assou, Lamiae El Bouamri, Mohammed Chalkha, Asmae Nakkabi, Samir Chtita, Reem M. Aljowaie, Mourad A. M. Aboul-Soud, Mohammed El Hassouni, John P. Giesy, Mohamed El Yazidi
This article reports comprehensive research on the synthesis of novel isoxazole-based heterocyclic hybrids, their characterization and the evaluation of their antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, employing both in vitro and in silico approaches.
